items.title: A People-First AI Fund: $50M to support nonprofits
items.summary: Applications are now open for OpenAI’s People-First AI Fund, a $50M initiative supporting U.S. nonprofits advancing education, community innovation, and economic opportunity. Apply by October 8, 2025, for unrestricted grants that help communities shape AI for the public good.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI宣布开放5000万美元的“People-First AI Fund”基金申请，旨在资助推动教育、社区创新和经济机会的美国非营利组织，帮助各地社区利用人工智能服务于公共利益。
